description: Updates come on the 1st and the 15th, grouped, and are merged once main's required checks pass, unless they raise a major version. release-please collects the fix(deps) ones, of what the binary contains, in the release pull request, which is merged by hand.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes come at once, outside the schedule.

customManagers.description: The CAPI core the tool installs, in code; it moves with the sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api module (same group), which a test checks.
The Bootstrap cluster's k0s image, pinned in code per release (docs/adr/0001-core-libraries.md).
golangci-lint's version in CI, kept the same as the dev container's.

packageRules.description: The Bootstrap cluster's k0s ships in the binary, so an update is a fix release-please releases. A new Kubernetes minor is raised by hand, with the CAPI minor that supports it.
The modules end up in the binary, so an update is a fix release-please releases.
The dev container, which no release contains.
golangci-lint in the dev container and in CI together, so they stay the same.
Each release is built against exactly one CAPI minor (see the support matrix in the README), so a new CAPI minor is raised by hand, as its own release; only its patch releases come from here.

Helm follows its newest minor, the only one it patches, and the Kubernetes libraries go where it requires (docs/adr/0001-core-libraries.md). They move together, and a minor merges only once the smoke test in CI passes on it. Kept out of the binary group so a break is isolated.
CAPI and the replace of its api module move together (docs/adr/0001-core-libraries.md).
A new Go minor version is raised by hand, in go.mod and the dev container together; only its patch releases and digests come from here.
A major version waits for review.
